independent_ground_truth.en: Rule applicability ground truth and positive-retention rate.

strongest_baseline.zh: SkillTracer、SkillAdaptor、自由文本重写、全部弃用。
strongest_baseline.en: SkillTracer, SkillAdaptor, free-text rewriting, and full deletion.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在规则可执行的工具环境中做 matched edits；仍需证明不是已有技能专化的直接实现。
decisive_pilot.en: Use matched edits in an executable-rule environment and prove separation from existing skill specialization.

stop_condition.zh: 单调限制导致过度收缩，或与 SkillAdaptor 等价时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if monotonicity causes excessive shrinkage or the method is equivalent to SkillAdaptor.

problem.zh: Agent 更新后沿用旧权限可能引入新越权，永久最低权限又损害效用。
problem.en: Reusing old permissions can create overreach, while permanent minimum privilege harms utility.

changed_assumption.zh: 临时权限集合由更新 diff 的风险预测产生，而不是每次统一降权。
changed_assumption.en: Derive temporary permission from update-diff risk rather than uniform downgrade.

exact_mechanism.zh: 编码 Prompt／记忆／技能／工作流 diff，预测受影响权限、必要重新授权 Probe 和不确定性；通过独立 Canary 后恢复。
exact_mechanism.en: Encode prompt/memory/skill/workflow diffs to predict affected permissions, required reauthorization probes, and uncertainty; restore after independent canaries.

learning_signal.zh: 更新 diff、Canary 结果、越权和任务效用标签。
learning_signal.en: Update diffs, canary outcomes, overreach, and utility labels.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 训练中未见更新算子上的安全—效用结果。
independent_ground_truth.en: Safety-utility outcomes on update operators absent from training.

strongest_baseline.zh: 静态最小权限、统一降权、ABAC/MAC、完整重认证。
strongest_baseline.en: Static least privilege, uniform downgrade, ABAC/MAC, and full reauthorization.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在 ToolPrivBench/AuthBench 风格环境中训练三类更新、留出第四类；当前需确认数据覆盖。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on three update types and hold out a fourth in ToolPrivBench/AuthBench-style tasks; data coverage must be confirmed.

stop_condition.zh: 未见更新算子上不能校准，或安全收益来自永久禁权时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if calibration fails on unseen update operators or safety gains come from permanent denial.

title.zh: 干预认证的 Reward 更新

problem.zh: Reward 漂移审计能发现问题，但不会产生更好的持久评价器。
problem.en: Reward-drift audits identify problems but do not create a better persistent evaluator.

changed_assumption.zh: 把独立认证的因果／中性干预作为 Reward 更新监督。
changed_assumption.en: Use independently certified causal and neutral interventions as reward-update supervision.

exact_mechanism.zh: 训练小型 Reward 修正头，使因果干预按已知方向改变排序、中性干预保持排序，并用校准约束限制更新幅度。
exact_mechanism.en: Train a small reward-correction head so causal interventions move rankings in certified directions, neutral interventions preserve rankings, and calibration limits update size.

learning_signal.zh: 独立生成并认证的因果／中性干预对。
learning_signal.en: Independently generated and certified causal/neutral intervention pairs.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 下游候选策略选择的独立成功真值。
independent_ground_truth.en: Independent success ground truth for downstream policy selection.

strongest_baseline.zh: 冻结 Reward、CROME、PRISM、普通 Pairwise Fine-tuning。
strongest_baseline.en: Frozen reward, CROME, PRISM, and ordinary pairwise fine-tuning.

decisive_pilot.zh: 先在可程序验证环境和开放权重 Reward 上验证；仍需补足直接碰撞审查。
decisive_pilot.en: First test in a programmatically verifiable environment with an open reward model; direct collision audit is still required.

stop_condition.zh: 只提高干预集而不提高冻结下游选择，或破坏中性校准时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it improves only the intervention set, not frozen downstream selection, or harms neutral calibration.

title.zh: 相邻 Checkpoint 判别课程

problem.zh: 按难度或失败率选任务，不能保证它们能区分相邻版本的真实改进。
problem.en: Difficulty or failure-rate curricula need not distinguish real improvement between adjacent versions.

changed_assumption.zh: 课程价值改为相邻 Checkpoint 的可重复判别力。
changed_assumption.en: Define curriculum value as replicated discrimination between adjacent checkpoints.

exact_mechanism.zh: 估计每个任务对相邻版本的效应量和不确定性，选择最大化未来版本区分度的任务，并保留随机审计。
exact_mechanism.en: Estimate task-level adjacent-version effects and uncertainty, select tasks maximizing future checkpoint discrimination, and retain random audits.

learning_signal.zh: 相邻版本 paired replay 的标准化差异。
learning_signal.en: Standardized differences from paired replay of adjacent versions.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 留出版本上对真实能力增长的预测。
independent_ground_truth.en: Prediction of true capability growth on held-out versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 失败率课程、难度课程、学习进度、随机采样。
strongest_baseline.en: Failure-rate, difficulty, learning-progress, and random curricula.

decisive_pilot.zh: 至少需要两条真实多轮版本流；当前无实验结果，因此先列为 repair。
decisive_pilot.en: Requires at least two real multi-round version streams and remains repair without them.

stop_condition.zh: 只有合成版本流，或判别分数不能预测圈外改进时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if only synthetic streams exist or discrimination does not predict out-of-loop improvement.

problem.zh: 多个更新组合后出现回退时，按时间或谱系回滚会撤销无害更新。
problem.en: Chronological or lineage rollback removes harmless updates when composed updates regress.

changed_assumption.zh: 谱系只作为依赖先验，真正回滚集合由预算受限干预识别。
changed_assumption.en: Lineage is only a dependency prior; the rollback set is identified by budgeted interventions.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把更新原子建成依赖图，主动选择最有信息量的启用／禁用组合，学习交互项并输出恢复回归测试的最小集合。
exact_mechanism.en: Build an update-atom dependency graph, actively select informative enable/disable combinations, learn interactions, and output the smallest rollback set restoring regressions.

learning_signal.zh: 组件启用／禁用干预对失败的因果效应。
learning_signal.en: Causal effects of component enable/disable interventions on failure.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 合成与真实更新序列中的最小故障集合。
independent_ground_truth.en: Minimal fault sets in synthetic and real update sequences.

strongest_baseline.zh: 最后更新回滚、逐个消融、Delta Debugging、Shapley 归因。
strongest_baseline.en: Last-update rollback, one-at-a-time ablation, delta debugging, and Shapley attribution.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在 4–8 个 Prompt／记忆／工作流更新中注入单点和双点交互故障，固定干预次数。
decisive_pilot.en: Inject single and pairwise faults into 4–8 prompt/memory/workflow updates under a fixed intervention budget.

stop_condition.zh: 不能比 Delta Debugging 用更少测试找到同样小的集合，或真实序列无收益时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it cannot match delta debugging with fewer tests or offers no gain on real sequences.

external_reviews.finding: The changed assumption is material: lineage becomes only a prior, while interventions identify a rollback set over persistent versioned updates. However, the learner is not yet distinguishable from dependency-aware probabilistic delta debugging plus interaction attribution. The proposal does not specify a posterior family, an intervention-acquisition objective, an estimator for stochastic agent outcomes, or the constrained decision rule that converts effects into the smallest restoring set. Planted synthetic fault sets are independent ground truth, but minimal fault sets in real update histories are not independently observable as stated.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该子方案的假设变化具有实质性：谱系仅作为先验，真正通过干预识别持久化版本更新中的回滚集合。但当前学习器仍无法与“依赖感知的概率化 Delta Debugging 加交互归因”区分开来；方案没有给出后验模型、干预采集目标、随机智能体结果的估计器，也没有给出把因果效应转换为最小恢复集合的约束决策规则。合成注入故障可提供独立真值，但真实更新历史中的最小故障集合按当前定义并不可独立观测。
external_reviews.required_action: Specify and freeze an interaction-aware fault posterior, a rollout-normalized acquisition rule, and an exact constrained decoder for the smallest restoring rollback set; then compare against dependency-aware ProbDD/PMA and Causal Agent Replay under identical total agent-rollout budgets on held-out models and real version histories.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 明确并冻结交互感知的故障后验、按 rollout 成本归一化的采集规则，以及求解最小恢复回滚集合的精确约束解码器；随后在相同智能体总 rollout 预算下，与依赖感知的 ProbDD/PMA 和 Causal Agent Replay 比较，并覆盖冻结后的跨模型测试与真实版本历史。

closest_work.title: Probabilistic Delta Debugging
Causal Agent Replay: Counterfactual Attribution for LLM-Agent Failures
Delta Debugging for LLM-integrated Systems

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is rollback over heterogeneous, persistent, versioned agent updates with a dependency prior and an explicit minimal-restoration objective; the closest work minimizes failure-inducing inputs or attributes trajectory steps rather than selecting which deployed updates to remove.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Dependency-aware ProbDD or probabilistic monotonicity assessment seeded with the same graph and allowed the same intervention history, plus a budget-matched interaction-aware Causal Agent Replay variant.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Inject single and pairwise faults into 4–8 heterogeneous updates, cap every method at six interventions and the same total agent rollouts, train the acquisition model on one agent/model, freeze it, and test exact restoring-set recovery, benign-update retention, and task restoration on a second model and real version sequences.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Falsify the thesis if it does not improve exact restoring-set recovery and benign-update retention over dependency-aware ProbDD/PMA at the same rollout budget, or if any gain disappears after freezing on the second model or on real version histories.
unknowns: How independently verified minimal fault sets will be obtained for real update histories.
Whether repeated enable/disable interventions are reproducible enough under stochastic agent execution.
Whether the proposed versioned update harness and dependency graphs will be released.

problem.zh: 一次恢复成功的轨迹可能在未来被错误检索并放大残余错误。
problem.en: A trajectory that recovers once may later be mis-retrieved and amplify residual error.

changed_assumption.zh: 恢复完整度由未来复用时的真实帮助／伤害学习，不再由手工轨迹条件定义。
changed_assumption.en: Learn recovery completeness from future reuse harm instead of hand-coded trajectory conditions.

exact_mechanism.zh: 在容量受限经验记忆中，输入失败类型、恢复点、残余状态和检索上下文，预测条目未来复用风险并选择写入、摘要或隔离。
exact_mechanism.en: In capacity-bounded experience memory, predict future reuse risk from failure type, recovery point, residual state, and retrieval context, then choose write, summarize, or quarantine.

learning_signal.zh: 未来任务 matched replay 的条目级净效应。
learning_signal.en: Entry-level net effects from matched replay on future tasks.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 独立时间留出任务上的复用伤害与帮助。
independent_ground_truth.en: Reuse harm and benefit on chronological held-out tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: 成功即写入、终点规则、摘要记忆、检索置信度门控。
strongest_baseline.en: Success-only admission, endpoint rules, summary memory, and retrieval-confidence gating.

decisive_pilot.zh: 两个任务域中冻结记忆容量和检索次数，比较负迁移、成功率和存储成本。
decisive_pilot.en: Freeze memory capacity and retrieval count in two domains and compare negative transfer, success, and storage cost.

stop_condition.zh: 不能跨任务域迁移，或简单成功／失败标签同样有效时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not transfer across domains or simple success/failure labels are equally effective.

external_reviews.finding: The child replaces hand-coded recovery completeness with an outcome-grounded future-harm target, and environment-scored held-out tasks can make that target independent. Yet it remains an underspecified admission controller. 'Matched replay' does not define the potential outcomes for write, summarize, and quarantine, retrieval exposure is a post-treatment variable, and the loss and action rule are absent. Recent work already learns memory admission or retention from future utility, downstream outcomes, and risk-sensitive control, so the novelty survives only if candidate-level counterfactual harm is randomized and action-specific.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该子方案用未来复用伤害这一结果驱动目标替代手工定义的恢复完整性；若由环境在留出任务上评分，该监督可以独立于同一模型。但它目前仍是一个定义不足的记忆准入控制器：“匹配回放”没有定义写入、摘要和隔离三种动作的潜在结果，检索暴露还是处理后的变量，同时缺少损失函数和动作决策规则。近期工作已利用未来效用、下游结果和风险敏感控制学习记忆准入或保留，因此只有在候选条目层面随机化暴露并定义动作特异的反事实伤害后，创新边界才成立。
external_reviews.required_action: Define candidate-level potential outcomes for write, summarize, and quarantine, randomize candidate exposure before retrieval, specify a multi-action policy loss and fixed decision rule, and test the frozen policy across domains against future-utility retention and A-MAC-style admission under equal capacity, replay, token, and solver-call budgets.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 为写入、摘要和隔离分别定义候选条目层面的潜在结果，在检索前随机化候选暴露，给出多动作策略损失与固定决策规则，并在容量、回放、token 和求解调用预算完全一致时，与基于未来效用的保留方法及 A-MAC 式准入方法进行冻结后的跨域比较。

closest_work.title: How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents: An Empirical Study of Experience-Following Behavior
Adaptive Memory Admission Control for LLM Agents
Learning When to Remember: Risk-Sensitive Contextual Bandits for Abstention-Aware Memory Retrieval in LLM-Based Coding Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is an entry-level, randomized estimate of future reuse harm that directly supervises persistent write, summarize, or quarantine actions, rather than proxy utility features, retrieval-time risk, or unrandomized downstream correlations.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: History-based selective addition/deletion trained on future-task utility labels, augmented with A-MAC features, under the same memory capacity and candidate-replay budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Randomize each candidate recovery experience among write, token-matched summary, and quarantine before future retrieval; hold retrieval count, memory capacity, context tokens, and solver calls fixed; train on ALFWorld, freeze, and test on a ToolBench subset using negative transfer, net utility, action calibration, and storage cost.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Falsify the thesis if simple success/failure labels or history-based future-utility retention match its harm reduction and utility at equal budgets, if the effect disappears cross-domain, or if summary benefits are explained by extra generation or context budget.
unknowns: How many independent future reuse opportunities each entry will receive.
Whether the selected ToolBench subset supplies deterministic, independently checkable task rewards.
Whether summary generation cost is included in the matched training and inference budgets.

problem.zh: 记忆条目平均有益，但会在少数未来任务上造成强干扰。
problem.en: Memory entries help on average but can severely harm a minority of future tasks.

changed_assumption.zh: 三臂重放不再只是审计，而是条目准入的唯一训练信号。
changed_assumption.en: Three-arm replay becomes the sole admission signal rather than an audit only.

exact_mechanism.zh: 对候选条目执行检索／打乱／无记忆 matched replay，用分层效应模型估计任务模式条件下的帮助与伤害后验，再学习带弃权的准入、隔离或删除策略。
exact_mechanism.en: Run retrieved/shuffled/no-memory matched replay, estimate motif-conditioned benefit and harm with a hierarchical effect model, and learn admission, quarantine, or deletion with abstention.

learning_signal.zh: 条目×任务模式的重复处理效应后验。
learning_signal.en: Replicated treatment-effect posteriors for each entry-by-task motif.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 按时间留出的未来任务上的可复现帮助或伤害。
independent_ground_truth.en: Replicated benefit or harm on chronological held-out tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: 写入全部成功经验、置信度门控、A-MAC／SCORE 类选择。
strongest_baseline.en: Write-all success memory, confidence gating, and A-MAC/SCORE-style selection.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebArena-Lite 时间任务流上匹配重放与存储预算，比较未来回退、收益和弃权率。
decisive_pilot.en: Use chronological ALFWorld and WebArena-Lite streams with matched replay/storage budgets.

stop_condition.zh: 第二模型上不能降低未来伤害，或成本—收益不优于无记忆时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if future harm does not fall on a second model or the frontier does not beat no-memory.

external_reviews.finding: Three-arm replay and hierarchical shrinkage make the causal admission signal substantially more concrete than the parent audit, and environment rewards can provide independent outcomes. However, shuffled memory is not a valid placebo unless token length, retrieval position, task difficulty, and semantic irrelevance are controlled; it may itself change execution difficulty. The hierarchical likelihood, prior, posterior-to-action thresholds, and online admission timing are also unspecified. SkillCAT and prior memory-management work already turn replay or downstream utility into retention decisions, leaving a plausible but not yet identifiable method boundary.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 三臂回放与分层收缩使因果准入信号相较父方案明显更具体，环境奖励也可以提供独立结果。但“打乱记忆”只有在 token 长度、检索位置、任务难度和语义无关性都受控时才可能作为有效安慰剂，否则它本身就会改变执行难度。方案还未给出分层似然、先验、从后验到动作的阈值以及在线准入时机。SkillCAT 和既有记忆管理工作已经把回放或下游效用转化为保留决策，因此当前仅保留了一个有潜力但尚不可识别的机制边界。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace the shuffled arm with a pre-registered, token- and position-matched irrelevant-memory placebo; specify the hierarchical likelihood, prior, abstention and action thresholds, and admission timing; then freeze the gate and compare it with a two-arm empirical-Bayes estimator and SkillCAT-style replay under identical total replay and storage budgets on a second model.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 用预注册的、token 数与位置匹配的无关记忆安慰剂替代简单打乱臂；明确分层似然、先验、弃判与动作阈值以及准入时机；随后冻结门控器，在第二个模型上以完全相同的总回放和存储预算，与两臂经验贝叶斯估计器及 SkillCAT 式回放比较。

closest_work.title: SkillCAT: Contrastive Assessment and Topology-Aware Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
How Memory Management Impacts LLM Agents: An Empirical Study of Experience-Following Behavior
Adaptive Memory Admission Control for LLM Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is replicated entry-by-task-motif treatment-effect estimation on future tasks, with a no-memory arm, a controlled placebo arm, posterior abstention, and persistent quarantine or deletion rather than source-task patch validation or proxy-score admission.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A two-arm retrieved-versus-no-memory randomized estimator with empirical-Bayes shrinkage and fixed posterior thresholds, using the same replay observations and memory actions.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: On chronological ALFWorld and WebArena-Lite streams, randomize retrieved memory, no memory, or a token- and position-matched irrelevant placebo; keep total replay executions, context tokens, storage, and task attempts equal; train on one model, freeze on the other, and compare future-harm rate, utility, coverage, and calibration.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Falsify the thesis if the controlled third arm does not reduce bias or uncertainty beyond the two-arm estimator, if the hierarchical gate does not improve the harm-utility-coverage frontier at matched replay cost, or if the gain fails on the second frozen model.
unknowns: The exact hierarchical model, prior, and minimum replication count per entry-by-motif cell.
Whether chronological streams provide enough repeated motif exposures for stable treatment-effect posteriors.
Whether WebArena-Lite executions are reproducible enough to separate memory effects from environment variance.

problem.zh: 新版本失败时，逐组件穷举替换成本高，双点交互故障更难定位。
problem.en: Exhaustive component swapping is costly and pairwise faults are hard to localize.

changed_assumption.zh: 从历史版本故障学习下一次最有信息量的组件替换，而不是固定 Delta Debugging 顺序。
changed_assumption.en: Learn the next informative component substitution from historical faults rather than using a fixed delta-debugging order.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把 Prompt、记忆、技能、工作流和小模块视为故障变量；策略根据后验选择最小替换实验，更新单点和交互故障概率并输出最小解释集合。
exact_mechanism.en: Treat prompt, memory, skill, workflow, and small modules as fault variables; select minimal substitutions, update single/interacting fault posteriors, and output the smallest explanation set.

learning_signal.zh: 历史版本中的组件替换结果和已知故障集合。
learning_signal.en: Component-substitution outcomes and known fault sets from prior versions.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见模型、版本和故障组合上的真实故障集合。
independent_ground_truth.en: True fault sets on unseen models, versions, and fault compositions.

strongest_baseline.zh: Delta Debugging、逐组件消融、日志归因、随机替换。
strongest_baseline.en: Delta debugging, one-component ablation, log attribution, and random substitution.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在 ALFWorld／WebArena-Lite 注入单点与双点故障，限制最多 6 次干预并跨模型冻结策略。
decisive_pilot.en: Inject single and pairwise faults in ALFWorld/WebArena-Lite, cap interventions at six, and freeze across models.

stop_condition.zh: 双点故障上不能用更少干预超过 Delta Debugging 时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it cannot beat delta debugging on pairwise faults with fewer interventions.

external_reviews.finding: The changed assumption only replaces a fixed delta-debugging order with a learned or probabilistic intervention order. That is already the central mechanism of ProbDD and related adaptive delta-debugging methods: maintain test-derived fault probabilities and select the next subset to maximize expected progress. Applying this template to prompts, memories, skills, workflows, and small modules, then returning the smallest explanation set, is a diagnostic controller and a direct recombination rather than a new persistent learning mechanism. Cross-model freezing tests generalization but does not create a surviving novelty boundary.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该子方案的假设变化仅是把固定的 Delta Debugging 顺序替换为学习式或概率式干预顺序，而这已经是 ProbDD 及其自适应后继方法的核心机制：根据测试维护故障概率，并选择最能提升预期进展的下一组子集。把这一模板应用到提示、记忆、技能、工作流和小模块，再输出最小解释集合，本质上仍是诊断控制器和已知方法的直接重组，而不是新的持久学习机制。跨模型冻结只能检验泛化，不能产生新的创新边界。
external_reviews.required_action: Abandon learned query ordering as the thesis and introduce a persistent intervention-derived repair or rollback representation whose deployed state changes after diagnosis and whose benefit cannot be reproduced by seeding ProbDD/PMA with the same historical faults; otherwise treat this child as an evaluation study, not an ICLR method.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 放弃把“学习查询顺序”作为论文主论点，改为提出一种由干预导出的持久化修复或回滚表示，使诊断后部署状态真正发生更新，并证明把同一历史故障先验提供给 ProbDD/PMA 也无法复现其收益；否则应把该子方案定位为评测研究，而不是 ICLR 方法。

closest_work.title: Probabilistic Delta Debugging
Accelerating Delta Debugging through Probabilistic Monotonicity Assessment
Delta Debugging for LLM-integrated Systems

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: ProbDD or probabilistic monotonicity assessment initialized with the identical historical fault prior and constrained to the same six component substitutions and executions.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Freeze both the proposed policy and a historical-prior ProbDD/PMA baseline, then test exact single- and pairwise-fault-set recovery on unseen models and versions under six substitutions and identical executions.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Keep the block verdict if the policy does not significantly improve exact fault-set recovery and intervention count over historical-prior ProbDD/PMA, or if gains occur only on synthetic injected faults with a fixed component vocabulary.
unknowns: The exact policy objective, posterior parameterization, and training corpus of historical faults.
Whether fault identities and component semantics are aligned across models and versions.
Whether any real version histories have independently verified interacting fault sets.

problem.zh: 经验在源任务上有因果收益，不代表跨任务族后仍有效。
problem.en: A lesson can be causally useful on its source task yet fail after task-family shift.

changed_assumption.zh: 准入目标从源任务有效性改为效应可迁移性。
changed_assumption.en: Change admission from source-task efficacy to effect transportability.

exact_mechanism.zh: 从多任务 matched replay 学习经验效应表示，寻找跨环境稳定的状态—约束特征，并输出带校准弃权的迁移证书。
exact_mechanism.en: Learn lesson-effect representations from multi-task matched replay, identify stable state-constraint features, and output a calibrated transport certificate with abstention.

learning_signal.zh: 源任务和目标任务上的条目级处理效应及环境描述。
learning_signal.en: Entry-level treatment effects and environment descriptors on source and target tasks.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 完全留出任务族上的效应符号和幅度。
independent_ground_truth.en: Effect sign and magnitude on fully held-out task families.

strongest_baseline.zh: 源任务因果准入、语义相似度、SkillCAT、A-MAC、SCORE。
strongest_baseline.en: Source causal admission, semantic similarity, SkillCAT, A-MAC, and SCORE.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三任务族训练、一任务族留出；相同记忆容量与重放预算，测量负迁移和有效覆盖。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on three task families and hold out one under equal memory and replay budgets; measure negative transfer and coverage.

stop_condition.zh: 效应符号预测不优于语义相似度，或覆盖率过低时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if effect-sign prediction does not beat semantic similarity or coverage is too low.

external_reviews.finding: The changed assumption targets a real gap: causal usefulness on a source task is not effect transportability, and held-out task-family outcomes can provide independent ground truth. However, 'lesson-effect representations' and 'stable state-constraint features' do not define a learning objective, invariance criterion, calibration method, or abstention threshold. Recent work already studies cross-domain memory transfer, negative transfer, learned transferable abstraction, and replay-validated skill admission. With only three source families, the proposed certificate can collapse to a standard conditional-treatment-effect or domain-similarity predictor and is not calibrated without explicit overlap and uncertainty assumptions.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该子方案瞄准了真实缺口：在源任务上具有因果效用并不等于效应可迁移，完全留出的任务族结果也能提供独立真值。但“经验效应表示”和“稳定状态约束特征”尚未定义学习目标、不变性判据、校准方法或弃判阈值。近期工作已经研究跨域记忆迁移、负迁移、可迁移抽象的学习以及基于回放验证的技能准入。仅使用三个源任务族时，该证书很可能退化为标准的条件处理效应预测器或域相似度预测器；若不明确重叠性和不确定性假设，也无法声称校准。
external_reviews.required_action: Formulate the certificate as cross-fitted treatment-effect estimation with an explicit invariant-representation objective, positivity and overlap checks, and conformal control of effect-sign error; require zero target-family labels at deployment, freeze across both family and model, and compare against an R-learner with conformal abstention and semantic similarity under equal memory and replay budgets.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 把证书明确形式化为交叉拟合的处理效应估计，并加入显式不变表示目标、正值性与支持重叠检查，以及对效应符号错误的 conformal 风险控制；部署时不得使用目标任务族标签，同时跨任务族和模型冻结，并在相同记忆与回放预算下，与带 conformal 弃判的 R-learner 和语义相似度基线比较。

closest_work.title: Memory Transfer Learning: How Memories are Transferred Across Domains in Coding Agents
Learning How to Remember: A Meta-Cognitive Management Method for Structured and Transferable Agent Memory
SkillCAT: Contrastive Assessment and Topology-Aware Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: The remaining boundary is a calibrated, abstaining certificate for the sign and magnitude of an individual lesson's causal effect on a fully unseen task family, with no target-family labels or extra deployment-time replay.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A cross-fitted R-learner or other standard CATE estimator with conformal abstention, trained on the same lesson and environment descriptors and given the same source-family treatment outcomes.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Randomize lesson exposure within at least four task families, train the certificate on three, freeze it, and test on the fourth plus a held-out model with zero target labels and no extra replay; match memory, tokens, and calls, and measure effect-sign error, calibration, selective coverage, downstream negative transfer, and net task utility.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Falsify the thesis if it does not outperform the R-learner/conformal and semantic-similarity baselines on held-out-family sign error and downstream utility, if coverage falls below 30% at a 5% sign-error target, or if gains vanish on the held-out model.
unknowns: Whether task-family descriptors needed by the certificate are available before observing target outcomes.
Whether the public task suites provide treatment overlap and enough repeated lesson-by-family effects for calibration.
Whether the proposed four-suite replay experiment is feasible within the claimed low-resource budget.

title.zh: 提交前工作流迁移证书

problem.zh: 工作流在发现任务上成功，但更换工具 API 或任务图模式后会静默失效。
problem.en: Workflows can succeed on discovery tasks yet silently fail on unseen APIs or task-graph motifs.

changed_assumption.zh: 证书是候选提交前的校准风险预测器，不是事后泛化分数。
changed_assumption.en: The certificate is a calibrated pre-commit risk predictor, not a post-hoc score.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把工作流表示为带工具语义和控制流的图，学习候选图编辑对未见 API／图模式失败概率的影响，并在不确定时拒绝提交。
exact_mechanism.en: Represent workflows as graphs with tool semantics and control flow; learn how candidate edits change failure probability on unseen APIs/motifs and abstain under uncertainty.

learning_signal.zh: 独立生成候选的图编辑、发现集表现和未来失败标签。
learning_signal.en: Graph edits, discovery performance, and future failure labels for independently generated candidates.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 未见 API 和任务图模式上的提交后成功率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Post-commit success on unseen APIs and task-graph motifs.

strongest_baseline.zh: 发现集成功率、图复杂度、随机测试、固定回归集。
strongest_baseline.en: Discovery success, graph complexity, random tests, and fixed regression suites.

decisive_pilot.zh: 独立生成 200–500 个小工作流，固定总测试预算，比较风险覆盖与错误提交率。
decisive_pilot.en: Generate 200–500 small workflows independently under a fixed test budget and compare risk coverage and bad-commit rate.

stop_condition.zh: 第二工具族上不能校准，或固定小回归集更优时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if uncalibrated on a second tool family or a fixed small regression suite is better.

external_reviews.finding: This remains a calibrated workflow-performance predictor rather than a learning mechanism that changes an agent's persistent behavior. Agentic Predictor and FLORA already encode workflow graphs, prompts, code, and interactions to predict workflow performance; conditioning the prediction on edits, unseen APIs, and abstention does not by itself create a new method thesis.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该方案本质上仍是校准后的工作流性能预测器，而不是改变智能体持久行为的学习机制。Agentic Predictor 和 FLORA 已利用工作流图、提示、代码及交互特征预测性能；增加编辑条件、未见 API 和拒判机制，本身不足以形成新的方法论主张。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace the certificate with an explicit risk-constrained workflow update operator whose objective and frozen edit policy causally improve held-out workflows over calibrated performance-predictor baselines under identical candidate and evaluation budgets.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将证书预测器替换为明确的风险约束工作流更新算子，给出其目标函数和冻结后的编辑策略，并在候选与评测预算完全一致时，证明其对未见工作流的因果收益超过校准后的性能预测器基线。

closest_work.title: Agentic Predictor: Performance Prediction for Agentic Workflows via Multi-View Encoding
FLORA: GNNs as Predictors of Agentic Workflow Performances

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Agentic Predictor augmented with uncertainty calibration and abstention, trained on exactly the same graph-edit features and post-commit failure labels.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Generate one fixed edit pool independently, train on one tool family, freeze all predictors, and compare bad-commit risk at matched coverage against a calibrated Agentic Predictor on jointly held-out API and graph-motif splits using identical regression executions.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the certificate does not lower bad-commit rate at matched coverage relative to the calibrated Agentic Predictor on both held-out splits, or if parity requires additional workflow executions.
unknowns: No loss function, uncertainty estimator, calibration procedure, or abstention threshold is specified.
The independence of candidate generation from the certificate training data is not defined.
The proposed workflow graph extractor and the construction of reliable unseen-API and motif labels are unspecified.

title.zh: 模拟器蒸馏的不可逆风险记忆

problem.zh: 不可逆动作需要反事实后果，但在线持续调用模拟器只是增加推理。
problem.en: Irreversible actions need counterfactual consequences, but online simulation is extra inference.

changed_assumption.zh: 模拟器只在发现阶段使用；部署时只能读取持久风险记忆。
changed_assumption.en: Use the simulator only during discovery; deployment may consult only persistent risk memory.

exact_mechanism.zh: 通过可验证状态替换生成动作后果对，蒸馏为带前置条件、风险等级和禁用动作的最小谓词库，冻结后关闭模拟器。
exact_mechanism.en: Generate verified action-consequence pairs via state substitutions and distill a minimal predicate library with preconditions, risk levels, and forbidden actions; disable the simulator after freezing.

learning_signal.zh: 独立转移验证器提供的反事实后果。
learning_signal.en: Counterfactual outcomes from an independent transition verifier.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 模拟器关闭时未见状态上的不可逆错误率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Irreversible-error rate on unseen states with the simulator disabled.

strongest_baseline.zh: 在线模拟器、自然语言反思、规则记忆、固定安全 Prompt。
strongest_baseline.en: Online simulator, verbal reflection, rule memory, and fixed safety prompts.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在一个精确转移环境中先发现后冻结，匹配模拟器调用预算，评测时彻底关闭模拟器。
decisive_pilot.en: Use discovery-then-freeze in one exact-transition environment with matched simulator calls and evaluate with the simulator off.

stop_condition.zh: 关闭模拟器后收益消失，或风险召回不能跨 seed 保持时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if gains vanish without the simulator or risk recall is unstable across seeds.

external_reviews.finding: Using an independent transition verifier during discovery and disabling simulation after freezing establishes a meaningful persistent-learning boundary. However, 'distill a minimal predicate library' is not yet an identifiable algorithm: the predicate language, soundness and coverage objectives, minimization rule, conflict handling, and retrieval decision are absent. CLIN, ICAL, and Memory-as-a-Tool already distill interaction feedback into persistent causal or procedural memory; the surviving novelty is specifically verifier-grounded counterfactual safety predicates for simulator-free deployment.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 在发现阶段使用独立转移验证器，并在冻结后关闭模拟器，确实建立了有意义的持久学习边界。但“蒸馏最小谓词库”尚不是可识别的算法：谓词语言、可靠性与覆盖目标、最小化规则、冲突处理和检索决策均未定义。CLIN、ICAL 和 Memory-as-a-Tool 已将交互反馈蒸馏为持久的因果或程序记忆；当前尚存的新颖边界是面向无模拟器部署、由验证器支撑的反事实安全谓词。
external_reviews.required_action: Specify a soundness-constrained predicate-induction objective and deterministic update rule, including the predicate hypothesis class, compression criterion, conflict resolution, and abstention behavior, then require frozen transfer to a second transition system.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 明确一个受可靠性约束的谓词归纳目标和确定性更新规则，包括谓词假设空间、压缩准则、冲突消解及拒判行为，并将冻结后迁移到第二个转移系统设为必要实验。

closest_work.title: CLIN: A Continually Learning Language Agent for Rapid Task Adaptation and Generalization
Distilling Feedback into Memory-as-a-Tool
VLM Agents Generate Their Own Memories: Distilling Experience into Embodied Programs of Thought

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Verified counterfactual state substitutions are compressed into an explicit risk-predicate library, and deployment is evaluated with simulator access prohibited.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A CLIN-style causal-abstraction memory constructed from exactly the same verifier-labeled counterfactual pairs and given the same memory and retrieval budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: In an exact-transition environment, allocate identical discovery states and simulator calls to the proposed predicate learner and a CLIN-style causal-memory baseline; freeze both, disable all simulator access, and evaluate irreversible-error recall, false blocks, and task success on unseen states and action compositions.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the frozen predicate memory does not reduce irreversible errors relative to the matched causal-memory baseline without increasing benign-action blocking, or if gains disappear on a second transition system.
unknowns: The irreversible-action taxonomy and the admissible state-substitution procedure are not specified.
No formal predicate language, induction loss, soundness constraint, or library minimization algorithm is supplied.
It is unclear whether ALFWorld's available transition checks support all proposed counterfactual substitutions without modifying the environment.
Transfer beyond one exact-transition environment has not been operationalized.

title.zh: 执行者—评价器交互残差门控

problem.zh: 执行者与评价器共同进化时，高分可能来自版本配对偏差。
problem.en: When actor and evaluator co-evolve, high scores may reflect version-pair bias.

changed_assumption.zh: 显式学习版本交互残差，而不是只冻结评价器或比较新旧评价器。
changed_assumption.en: Explicitly learn version interaction residuals rather than only freezing or pairing evaluators.

exact_mechanism.zh: 将 actor×evaluator 评分矩阵分解为任务难度、actor 能力、evaluator 偏置和交互残差，用未来留出轮次校准异常门控。
exact_mechanism.en: Factor the actor-by-evaluator matrix into task difficulty, actor ability, evaluator bias, and interaction residual; calibrate the residual gate on held-out future rounds.

learning_signal.zh: 跨版本交叉评分矩阵与独立锚点任务。
learning_signal.en: Cross-version score matrix and independent anchor tasks.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 冻结外部验证器上的真实能力变化。
independent_ground_truth.en: True capability change under a frozen external verifier.

strongest_baseline.zh: 冻结 Reward、最新版本配对、Reward Ensemble、当前轮一致性。
strongest_baseline.en: Frozen reward, latest-version pairing, reward ensemble, and current-round consistency.

decisive_pilot.zh: 构造 5–8 轮 actor/evaluator 更新，匹配评价调用，在未来轮次预测伪改进和真实回退。
decisive_pilot.en: Construct 5–8 rounds with matched evaluator calls and predict pseudo-improvement and true regression.

stop_condition.zh: 交互残差不能比冻结 Reward 或 Ensemble 更好预测外部真值时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if interaction residuals do not beat frozen rewards or ensembles on external ground truth.

external_reviews.finding: This is a statistical bias-detection and commit gate, not a new learning mechanism for either the actor or evaluator. Decomposing scores into task difficulty, actor ability, evaluator bias, and interaction residual closely follows established rater, latent-score, and interaction modeling; recent work already addresses iteration consistency, judge-specific deviations, and evaluator-policy co-evolution. The proposal does not specify how residuals produce a novel persistent update beyond accepting or rejecting a version.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该方案是统计偏差检测与提交门控，而不是针对 actor 或 evaluator 的新学习机制。将评分分解为任务难度、actor 能力、evaluator 偏差和交互残差，与既有评分者模型、潜在分数模型及交互建模高度一致；近期工作也已处理跨轮一致性、评审器特定偏差和评审器—策略协同演化。方案没有说明残差如何产生超出版本接受或拒绝之外的新型持久更新。
external_reviews.required_action: Change the update surface from a commit gate to an explicit residual-corrected evaluator or policy-training rule, with an identifiable objective that improves externally verified capability rather than only predicting biased version pairs.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将更新面从提交门控改为明确的残差校正评审器或策略训练规则，给出可识别的目标函数，并证明其提升外部验证的真实能力，而不只是预测存在偏差的版本组合。

closest_work.title: CREAM: Consistency Regularized Self-Rewarding Language Models
Bridging Human and LLM Judgments: Understanding and Narrowing the Gap
Co-Evolving LLM Evaluators and Policies via DynamicRubric

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A Bridge-style latent capability and evaluator-deviation model calibrated on the same external anchors, combined with CREAM-style cross-iteration consistency.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Fit all methods on the same early-round actor-by-evaluator matrix and external anchors, freeze them, and compare calibration, pseudo-improvement detection, and regression-preventing commit utility on future rounds and a held-out actor-evaluator family.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the interaction-residual gate fails to improve both calibration and externally measured commit utility over the anchor-calibrated latent-score baseline, or if residual rankings are unstable across seeds and equivalent factorization constraints.
unknowns: The factorization loss, link function, regularization, and identifiability constraints are unspecified.
The number and provenance of independent anchor tasks are not defined.
The gate threshold and the cost assigned to false commits versus false rejections are unspecified.
It is unclear whether actor and evaluator versions are independently trained or share data and checkpoints that confound the residual.

title.zh: 资产级模型替换兼容证书

problem.zh: 更换基础模型时，Prompt、记忆、技能和工作流会以不同方式静默失效。
problem.en: Prompts, memories, skills, and workflows can silently fail differently after a model swap.

changed_assumption.zh: 证书单位从整个 Agent 改为单个持久资产，并带不确定性和弃权。
changed_assumption.en: Change the certificate unit from the whole agent to each persistent asset with uncertainty and abstention.

exact_mechanism.zh: 用小型行为 Probe 和资产结构特征预测负迁移、适配成本和失败类型，同时在目标模型家族和资产类别上双重留出。
exact_mechanism.en: Use small behavioral probes and asset-structure features to predict negative transfer, adaptation cost, and failure type with double-held-out model-family and asset-class tests.

learning_signal.zh: 迁移前 Probe、资产表示和迁移后真实性能。
learning_signal.en: Pre-migration probes, asset representations, and post-migration ground truth.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 留出模型家族×留出资产类别上的负迁移。
independent_ground_truth.en: Negative transfer on held-out model families and asset classes.

strongest_baseline.zh: 全量迁移测试、语义相似度、MASA、SkCC、源模型成功率。
strongest_baseline.en: Full migration tests, semantic similarity, MASA, SkCC, and source success.

decisive_pilot.zh: 三开放模型家族、四类资产和两个任务域，冻结模型并匹配 Probe 预算。
decisive_pilot.en: Use three open model families, four asset classes, and two domains with frozen models and matched probe budgets.

stop_condition.zh: 双重留出校准失败，或成本接近全量迁移时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if double-held-out calibration fails or cost approaches full migration testing.

external_reviews.finding: Changing the unit from a whole agent to individual assets improves diagnostic resolution but does not convert the proposal into a learning method. It remains a probe-based compatibility predictor and registry. PromptBridge already learns cross-model prompt mappings, MASA adapts skills to target backbones, SkCC compiles skills across frameworks, and recent memory-transfer work measures model- and domain-dependent negative transfer. Unifying these assets under one abstaining certificate is an audit layer rather than a standalone ICLR mechanism.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 将评估单位从完整智能体细化到单个资产提高了诊断分辨率，但并未把方案转化为学习方法。它仍然是基于探针的兼容性预测器和注册表。PromptBridge 已学习跨模型提示映射，MASA 针对目标骨干适配技能，SkCC 在不同框架间编译技能，近期记忆迁移工作也已研究模型与领域相关的负迁移。将这些资产统一到一个可拒判证书下，仍属于审计层而非独立的 ICLR 机制。
external_reviews.required_action: Narrow to one asset class and replace compatibility prediction with a learned migration operator that transforms the asset, has an explicit training objective, and remains frozen when transferred to held-out model families.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 收窄到一种资产类别，并以学习得到的迁移算子替代兼容性预测；该算子应实际变换资产、具有明确训练目标，并在迁移到未见模型家族时保持冻结。

closest_work.title: PromptBridge: Cross-Model Prompt Transfer for Large Language Models
Skill is Not One-Size-Fits-All: Model-Aware Skill Alignment for LLM Agents
SkCC: Portable and Secure Skill Compilation for Cross-Framework LLM Agents
Memory Transfer Learning: How Memories are Transferred Across Domains in Coding Agents

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Separate asset-specialist models using PromptBridge for prompts, MASA or SkCC for skills, and a memory-transfer predictor for memories, all allocated the same total probe budget.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Under a fixed probe budget, compare one universal asset certificate with independently trained per-asset predictors and full migration testing on a double-held-out model-family and asset-class split, measuring negative-transfer recall, calibration, abstention, and total migration cost.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if double-held-out negative-transfer calibration fails for any asset class, if the universal model is worse than per-class predictors at matched coverage, or if probe cost approaches full migration testing.
unknowns: No shared representation capable of encoding prompts, memories, skills, and workflows is defined.
The labels for adaptation cost and failure type are not operationalized consistently across asset classes.
The identities and architectural diversity of the three proposed model families are unspecified.
ALFWorld and WebArena-Lite do not by themselves provide standardized instances of all four persistent asset classes.
The independence and cost of post-migration ground-truth evaluation are not specified.

title.zh: 反事实进化决策控制器

problem.zh: 继续搜索、提交、回滚或停止通常基于不同候选序列，无法公平学习决策。
problem.en: Continue, commit, rollback, and stop are usually compared on different candidate sequences.

changed_assumption.zh: 固定同一进化状态和候选序列，为四种决策构建反事实结果。
changed_assumption.en: Freeze the same evolution state and candidate sequence and construct counterfactual outcomes for all four decisions.

exact_mechanism.zh: 在一个持久更新表面上建立可反事实重放数据集，用保守离线策略学习在预算和回退约束下选择 continue／commit／rollback／stop。
exact_mechanism.en: Build a counterfactually replayable dataset for one persistent update surface and learn a conservative offline policy over continue/commit/rollback/stop under budget and regression constraints.

learning_signal.zh: 同一状态下四种动作的验证收益、未来回退和额外成本。
learning_signal.en: Validation gain, future regression, and extra cost for four actions from the same state.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 冻结测试流上的累计效用和最坏回退。
independent_ground_truth.en: Cumulative utility and worst regression on a frozen test stream.

strongest_baseline.zh: 固定轮数、阈值提交、Bandit、失败即回滚。
strongest_baseline.en: Fixed rounds, threshold commit, bandit control, and rollback-on-failure.

decisive_pilot.zh: 先在小型离线重放环境中匹配候选和调用预算，再冻结策略跨模型评测。
decisive_pilot.en: Match candidate and call budgets in an offline replay environment, then freeze the controller across models.

stop_condition.zh: 第二模型上不优于简单阈值，或需要重新生成候选才能成立时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat a simple threshold on a second model or requires regenerated candidates.

external_reviews.finding: Branching the same evolution state and candidate sequence across continue, commit, rollback, and stop is a valuable experimental design that can remove candidate-sequence confounding. However, 'learn a conservative offline policy' is a generic application of offline reinforcement learning rather than an identifiable new rule. Offline RL has already been used to control frozen LLM-agent harnesses, while prior work covers offline prompt optimization and continue-or-rollback control. The surviving boundary is a paired counterfactual controller specifically governing persistent updates.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 让同一演化状态和候选序列分别执行继续、提交、回滚和停止，是有价值的实验设计，可消除候选序列混杂。但“学习保守离线策略”只是离线强化学习的通用应用，尚不是可识别的新规则。已有工作已使用离线强化学习控制冻结的 LLM 智能体执行框架，也已有离线提示优化及继续或回滚控制。尚存的边界是专门管理持久更新、使用配对反事实结果训练的控制器。
external_reviews.required_action: Define a counterfactual paired-regret objective and support-constrained policy update that explicitly exploits all four same-state outcomes, then demonstrate that it outperforms standard offline-RL and threshold policies without regenerating candidates.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 定义一个明确利用同一状态下四种结果的反事实配对后悔目标和受数据支持约束的策略更新，并证明它在不重新生成候选的条件下优于标准离线强化学习和阈值策略。

closest_work.title: Learning to Control LLM Agent Harnesses with Offline Reinforcement Learning
Query-Dependent Prompt Evaluation and Optimization with Offline Inverse RL
CognitionLight: Continue, Rethink, or Rollback? Signaling for Persona-Aware Reasoning in Intelligent Agents

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Every evolution state is evaluated under continue, commit, rollback, and stop using the same candidate sequence, and the frozen controller governs persistent prompt or memory updates rather than inference-time reasoning steps.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: Advantage-weighted regression trained on the same replay table, together with a tuned regression-aware threshold policy using validation gain, future regression, and cost.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Construct a replay table in which each eligible state shares an identical candidate sequence across all four actions; train on one model, freeze the controller, and compare paired-regret learning, advantage-weighted regression, a contextual bandit, and a tuned threshold on a second model under identical candidate, call, and training budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the frozen controller does not beat the tuned threshold on both cumulative utility and worst regression on the second model, if gains require regenerated candidates, or if the learned policy frequently selects actions unsupported by the replay data.
unknowns: The conservative offline-learning objective, policy parameterization, constraint formulation, and optimization algorithm are unspecified.
Continue and commit outcomes may alter later candidate availability, making exact same-sequence counterfactual replay path-dependent.
The replay dataset's state-action coverage and treatment of unsupported actions are not defined.
The separation between validation signals used for learning and the frozen test stream used as ground truth is unspecified.
It is unclear whether rollback and stop outcomes can be evaluated without leaking future information unavailable at decision time.

problem.zh: 反例修复记忆时，自由文本编辑会破坏原本正确的适用区域。
problem.en: Free-text counterexample repair can damage regions where the original lesson was correct.

changed_assumption.zh: 每次反例只允许缩小适用集合，不允许任意改写经验含义。
changed_assumption.en: Each counterexample may only shrink the applicability set, not arbitrarily rewrite semantics.

exact_mechanism.zh: 把经验表示为可执行前置条件和例外集合；反例触发最小约束添加，保存可回放例外谱系并验证未受影响正例。
exact_mechanism.en: Represent lessons with executable preconditions and exception sets; counterexamples add minimal constraints, preserve replayable lineage, and verify unaffected positives.

learning_signal.zh: 约束删除得到的最小反例和未受影响正例。
learning_signal.en: Constraint-deletion minimal counterexamples and unaffected positives.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 规则适用真值与正例保持率。
independent_ground_truth.en: Rule applicability ground truth and positive-retention rate.

strongest_baseline.zh: SkillTracer、SkillAdaptor、自由文本重写、全部弃用。
strongest_baseline.en: SkillTracer, SkillAdaptor, free-text rewriting, and full deletion.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在规则可执行的工具环境中做 matched edits；仍需证明不是已有技能专化的直接实现。
decisive_pilot.en: Use matched edits in an executable-rule environment and prove separation from existing skill specialization.

stop_condition.zh: 单调限制导致过度收缩，或与 SkillAdaptor 等价时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if monotonicity causes excessive shrinkage or the method is equivalent to SkillAdaptor.

problem.zh: Agent 更新后沿用旧权限可能引入新越权，永久最低权限又损害效用。
problem.en: Reusing old permissions can create overreach, while permanent minimum privilege harms utility.

changed_assumption.zh: 临时权限集合由更新 diff 的风险预测产生，而不是每次统一降权。
changed_assumption.en: Derive temporary permission from update-diff risk rather than uniform downgrade.

exact_mechanism.zh: 编码 Prompt／记忆／技能／工作流 diff，预测受影响权限、必要重新授权 Probe 和不确定性；通过独立 Canary 后恢复。
exact_mechanism.en: Encode prompt/memory/skill/workflow diffs to predict affected permissions, required reauthorization probes, and uncertainty; restore after independent canaries.

learning_signal.zh: 更新 diff、Canary 结果、越权和任务效用标签。
learning_signal.en: Update diffs, canary outcomes, overreach, and utility labels.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 训练中未见更新算子上的安全—效用结果。
independent_ground_truth.en: Safety-utility outcomes on update operators absent from training.

strongest_baseline.zh: 静态最小权限、统一降权、ABAC/MAC、完整重认证。
strongest_baseline.en: Static least privilege, uniform downgrade, ABAC/MAC, and full reauthorization.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在 ToolPrivBench/AuthBench 风格环境中训练三类更新、留出第四类；当前需确认数据覆盖。
decisive_pilot.en: Train on three update types and hold out a fourth in ToolPrivBench/AuthBench-style tasks; data coverage must be confirmed.

stop_condition.zh: 未见更新算子上不能校准，或安全收益来自永久禁权时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if calibration fails on unseen update operators or safety gains come from permanent denial.

title.zh: 干预认证的 Reward 更新

problem.zh: Reward 漂移审计能发现问题，但不会产生更好的持久评价器。
problem.en: Reward-drift audits identify problems but do not create a better persistent evaluator.

changed_assumption.zh: 把独立认证的因果／中性干预作为 Reward 更新监督。
changed_assumption.en: Use independently certified causal and neutral interventions as reward-update supervision.

exact_mechanism.zh: 训练小型 Reward 修正头，使因果干预按已知方向改变排序、中性干预保持排序，并用校准约束限制更新幅度。
exact_mechanism.en: Train a small reward-correction head so causal interventions move rankings in certified directions, neutral interventions preserve rankings, and calibration limits update size.

learning_signal.zh: 独立生成并认证的因果／中性干预对。
learning_signal.en: Independently generated and certified causal/neutral intervention pairs.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 下游候选策略选择的独立成功真值。
independent_ground_truth.en: Independent success ground truth for downstream policy selection.

strongest_baseline.zh: 冻结 Reward、CROME、PRISM、普通 Pairwise Fine-tuning。
strongest_baseline.en: Frozen reward, CROME, PRISM, and ordinary pairwise fine-tuning.

decisive_pilot.zh: 先在可程序验证环境和开放权重 Reward 上验证；仍需补足直接碰撞审查。
decisive_pilot.en: First test in a programmatically verifiable environment with an open reward model; direct collision audit is still required.

stop_condition.zh: 只提高干预集而不提高冻结下游选择，或破坏中性校准时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if it improves only the intervention set, not frozen downstream selection, or harms neutral calibration.

title.zh: 相邻 Checkpoint 判别课程

problem.zh: 按难度或失败率选任务，不能保证它们能区分相邻版本的真实改进。
problem.en: Difficulty or failure-rate curricula need not distinguish real improvement between adjacent versions.

changed_assumption.zh: 课程价值改为相邻 Checkpoint 的可重复判别力。
changed_assumption.en: Define curriculum value as replicated discrimination between adjacent checkpoints.

exact_mechanism.zh: 估计每个任务对相邻版本的效应量和不确定性，选择最大化未来版本区分度的任务，并保留随机审计。
exact_mechanism.en: Estimate task-level adjacent-version effects and uncertainty, select tasks maximizing future checkpoint discrimination, and retain random audits.

learning_signal.zh: 相邻版本 paired replay 的标准化差异。
learning_signal.en: Standardized differences from paired replay of adjacent versions.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 留出版本上对真实能力增长的预测。
independent_ground_truth.en: Prediction of true capability growth on held-out versions.

strongest_baseline.zh: 失败率课程、难度课程、学习进度、随机采样。
strongest_baseline.en: Failure-rate, difficulty, learning-progress, and random curricula.

decisive_pilot.zh: 至少需要两条真实多轮版本流；当前无实验结果，因此先列为 repair。
decisive_pilot.en: Requires at least two real multi-round version streams and remains repair without them.

stop_condition.zh: 只有合成版本流，或判别分数不能预测圈外改进时停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if only synthetic streams exist or discrimination does not predict out-of-loop improvement.

problem.zh: 当前回滚方法只定位一次故障集合，不能把本次干预转化为未来更新组合的持久约束。
problem.en: Current rollback methods localize one fault set but do not convert interventions into persistent constraints for future update compositions.

changed_assumption.zh: 回滚输出不再只是组件集合，而是可泛化到未来更新描述符的持久 no-good／compatibility 子句。
changed_assumption.en: Rollback outputs persistent no-good and compatibility clauses over update descriptors rather than only a component set.

exact_mechanism.zh: 以稀疏高阶因子图表示更新原子及交互，使用 Beta-Bernoulli 结果模型估计回归概率；按单位 rollout 的期望互信息选择启用／禁用干预；通过最小成本 0-1 解码器求解满足回归风险上界的回滚集合；成功恢复后把最小不满足核编译为带来源和置信度的更新兼容子句，约束未来 commit。
exact_mechanism.en: Represent update atoms and interactions with a sparse higher-order factor graph and a Beta-Bernoulli outcome model; select enable/disable interventions by expected mutual information per rollout; decode the minimum-cost rollback set under a regression-risk bound; after restoration, compile the minimal unsatisfied core into provenance- and confidence-bearing compatibility clauses that constrain future commits.

learning_signal.zh: 组件组合的随机 rollout 成败、回归幅度和干预成本。
learning_signal.en: Stochastic rollout success, regression magnitude, and intervention cost for update combinations.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 注入故障真值；真实历史中以独立回归集是否恢复为可观测真值，未来组合以子句是否提前阻断回退为真值。
independent_ground_truth.en: Planted fault truth; independent regression-suite restoration for real histories; future-composition regressions prevented by learned clauses.

strongest_baseline.zh: ProbDD、PMA、Delta Debugging、Causal Agent Replay，以及拿到同一历史先验但不学习兼容子句的版本。
strongest_baseline.en: ProbDD, PMA, delta debugging, Causal Agent Replay, and a matched-history variant that does not learn compatibility clauses.

decisive_pilot.zh: 第一阶段匹配干预预算定位当前故障；第二阶段冻结已学子句，在未见更新组合与第二模型上测量回退率、所需干预数和错误阻断率。
decisive_pilot.en: Match intervention budgets for current localization, then freeze learned clauses and test regressions, interventions, and false blocks on unseen update combinations and a second model.

stop_condition.zh: 若同历史先验的 ProbDD/PMA 在未来组合上达到相同回退率，或子句错误阻断率超过 5%，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if ProbDD/PMA with the same history matches future-composition regression rate or clause false-block rate exceeds 5%.

external_reviews.finding: The changed assumption is material: rollback evidence becomes persistent constraints over future update compositions rather than a one-shot fault set. The update surface, independent regression signal, frozen-transfer test, and matched-budget ablation are credible. However, the central learning step is not yet mathematically identifiable. A stochastic Beta-Bernoulli factor posterior does not directly define a logical unsatisfied core, and the proposal does not specify the clause language, confidence semantics, generalization rule, or objective that converts noisy intervention outcomes into reusable higher-order prohibitions. Existing work already covers probabilistic delta debugging, intervention-based agent failure attribution, and persistent governed symbolic repair; the surviving thesis therefore depends entirely on a precise and demonstrably useful probabilistic clause-induction rule.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该子方案对父问题作出了实质性改变：回滚证据不再只输出一次性的故障集合，而是转化为约束未来更新组合的持久规则。更新表面、独立回归信号、冻结迁移测试和预算匹配消融均较可信。但核心学习步骤尚未具备数学可识别性：随机的 Beta-Bernoulli 因子后验并不会自然产生逻辑上的不可满足核心，方案也未定义子句语言、置信度语义、泛化规则，以及如何把带噪干预结果转化为可复用的高阶禁止规则。现有工作已经覆盖概率式差分调试、基于干预的智能体故障归因和持久化受治理符号修复，因此剩余的方法论文主张完全取决于一个精确定义且确有增益的概率子句归纳规则。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace the informal minimal-unsatisfied-core compilation with an explicit probabilistic clause-induction objective over a fixed typed descriptor language, including posterior updates, clause confidence and expiry, false-block control, and a comparison against a direct posterior-risk gate trained from exactly the same intervention history.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 将非正式的“最小不可满足核心编译”替换为固定类型化描述符语言上的显式概率子句归纳目标，明确后验更新、子句置信度与失效机制、误阻断控制，并与使用完全相同干预历史训练的直接后验风险门控进行比较。

closest_work.title: ANNEAL: Adapting LLM Agents via Governed Symbolic Patch Learning
Causal Agent Replay: Counterfactual Attribution for LLM-Agent Failures
Accelerating Delta Debugging through Probabilistic Monotonicity Assessment
SKILL.nb: Selective Formalization and Gated Execution for Durable Agent Workflows

direct_collision.surviving_difference: Learning confidence-bearing no-good and compatibility clauses over higher-order update descriptors from stochastic rollback interventions, then freezing those clauses to prevent regressions on unseen update compositions rather than merely repairing, gating, or localizing the current failure.

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: The same sparse interaction posterior and intervention history used as a direct composition-risk predictor and blocker, without compiling clauses, alongside PMA or ProbDD for current-fault localization.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Under identical update histories and rollout budgets, train the proposed clause registry and a direct posterior-risk gate on one model and two task domains; freeze both and evaluate unseen higher-order update combinations on a second model, measuring prevented regressions, unnecessary interventions, false blocks, and calibration.

problem.zh: 写入、摘要、隔离和删除对未来复用有不同潜在结果，但现有记忆准入只观察被选择动作。

changed_assumption.en: Randomize candidate-entry actions before retrieval exposure and directly learn action-specific future reuse effects.

exact_mechanism.zh: 使用分层探索策略在 write／summarize／quarantine／drop 间随机化；以跨拟合 doubly-robust 估计器学习每个动作的未来效用与伤害；用带支持约束的悲观策略目标最大化效用下界，并以固定 margin 和不确定性阈值执行动作或弃判。
exact_mechanism.en: Randomize among write/summarize/quarantine/drop with stratified exploration; learn future utility and harm using cross-fitted doubly robust estimators; optimize a support-constrained pessimistic lower bound and execute or abstain with frozen margin and uncertainty thresholds.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 随机化产生的动作特异潜在结果估计；留出时间任务上的环境真值。
independent_ground_truth.en: Randomization-supported action-specific potential outcomes and environment truth on chronological holdout tasks.

strongest_baseline.zh: A-MAC、未来效用保留、风险敏感 contextual bandit、成功即写入和只删除策略。
strongest_baseline.en: A-MAC, future-utility retention, risk-sensitive contextual bandits, success-only write, and deletion-only policies.

decisive_pilot.zh: 固定探索、记忆容量、检索次数和 Token 预算，在两个任务域训练并冻结到第三任务域；主表报告效用下界、负迁移和有效覆盖。
decisive_pilot.en: Fix exploration, capacity, retrieval, and token budgets; train on two domains and freeze to a third; report utility lower bound, negative transfer, and valid coverage.

stop_condition.zh: 若悲观策略不优于标准 contextual bandit，或跨域有效覆盖低于 40%，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if the pessimistic policy does not beat a standard contextual bandit or cross-domain valid coverage is below 40%.

external_reviews.finding: The proposal is statistically coherent and improves identification over an observational future-harm predictor, but it does not supply a new memory-learning mechanism. Randomizing a finite action set, estimating action values with cross-fitted doubly robust estimators, and optimizing a support-constrained pessimistic policy are standard contextual-bandit and offline-policy-learning components. Recent memory systems already formulate memory operations as learned actions, use contextual-bandit exploration and delayed credit, include summarize or forget operations, and make abstention or non-use first-class decisions. Applying a canonical causal-policy stack to write, summarize, quarantine, and drop is therefore a direct recombination rather than a standalone ICLR method invention.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该方案在统计上是连贯的，也比观察式未来危害预测器具有更强的可识别性，但它没有提出新的记忆学习机制。对有限动作集合进行随机化、使用交叉拟合双重稳健估计器估计动作价值，再优化受支持集约束的悲观策略，均属于标准的上下文赌博机和离线策略学习组件。近期记忆系统已经把记忆操作建模为可学习动作，采用上下文赌博机探索和延迟信用分配，包含摘要或遗忘操作，并将弃权或不使用记忆作为一等决策。因此，把经典因果策略学习流程应用于写入、摘要、隔离和删除，属于已有方法的直接重组，而不是独立的 ICLR 方法发明。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace the generic bandit formulation with a memory-specific causal mechanism that identifies retrieval-mediated delayed effects and interference among entries, and demonstrate an estimator or learning rule that cannot be reduced to a standard doubly robust contextual-bandit learner on the same randomized logs.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 用记忆特有的因果机制替换通用赌博机建模，使其能够识别由后续检索介导的延迟效应和不同记忆条目之间的干扰，并证明所提出的估计器或学习规则不能被相同随机日志上的标准双重稳健上下文赌博机学习器替代。

title.zh: 安慰剂校准的记忆效应模型

problem.zh: 无记忆对照无法区分语义帮助与单纯增加上下文、位置或执行难度的效应。
problem.en: A no-memory control cannot separate semantic help from context-length, position, or execution-difficulty effects.

changed_assumption.zh: 使用预注册、Token 与位置匹配、任务不相交的无关记忆作为负对照，并把负对照泄漏显式纳入后验。

exact_mechanism.zh: 对成功率使用 motif 随机截距的 Beta-Binomial 分层模型，对连续回报使用共享方差层次模型；估计 retrieved−no-memory 的总效应与 placebo−no-memory 的非语义效应，语义效应为二者差；仅当伤害后验超过阈值且 placebo 校准误差在界内时隔离或删除，否则弃判。
exact_mechanism.en: Use a Beta-Binomial hierarchical model with motif random intercepts for success and a shared-variance hierarchy for continuous reward; estimate total retrieved-minus-none and nonsemantic placebo-minus-none effects, defining semantic effect as their difference; quarantine/delete only when harm posterior exceeds a frozen threshold and placebo calibration error is bounded, otherwise abstain.

learning_signal.en: Matched future-task replay under retrieved, no-memory, and controlled irrelevant-memory arms.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 预注册安慰剂池的任务不相交性、环境回报和跨 seed 重复效应。
independent_ground_truth.en: Preregistered task-disjoint placebo pool, environment rewards, and cross-seed replicated effects.

strongest_baseline.zh: 两臂经验贝叶斯、SkillCAT、普通三臂均值差、A-MAC。
strongest_baseline.en: Two-arm empirical Bayes, SkillCAT, ordinary three-arm mean differences, and A-MAC.

decisive_pilot.zh: 冻结安慰剂池、似然、先验和阈值，在第二模型和第二任务域复用；匹配总回放、上下文和存储预算。

external_reviews.finding: This remains an evaluation and gating procedure rather than a new learning mechanism. The hierarchical posterior and three replay arms are concrete, but defining semantic effect as retrieved-minus-none minus placebo-minus-none is causally valid only if the placebo is exchangeable with the real memory for every nonsemantic pathway and if semantic and nonsemantic effects do not interact. Token, position, and task-disjoint matching do not establish those assumptions; an irrelevant memory can change reasoning, difficulty, attention, or tool behavior in content-dependent ways. Controlled intervention-based memory selection and quantified irrelevant-context effects are already covered by recent work, while the proposed persistent state is only a posterior-triggered quarantine registry.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该方案仍然属于评估与门控流程，而不是新的学习机制。层次后验和三种重放实验臂较为具体，但把语义效应定义为“真实记忆相对无记忆的效应减去安慰剂相对无记忆的效应”，只有在安慰剂与真实记忆对所有非语义作用路径均可交换，且语义效应与非语义效应不存在交互时才具有因果有效性。令牌数、位置和任务不相交匹配无法保证这些假设；无关记忆仍可能以内容相关方式改变推理、难度、注意力或工具行为。近期工作已经覆盖基于受控干预的记忆选择和无关上下文效应量化，而该方案的持久状态仅是由后验阈值触发的隔离登记表。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace the single irrelevant-placebo subtraction with a randomized factorial intervention that independently manipulates semantic content and surface/context properties, state the identification assumptions, and learn a transferable correction or decision model whose contribution is tested beyond the controlled audit.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 用随机析因干预替换单一无关安慰剂相减，使语义内容与表面或上下文属性能够被独立操纵，明确因果识别假设，并学习一个可迁移的校正或决策模型，使其贡献能够在受控审计之外接受检验。

external_reviews.finding: The child is materially more precise and retains a potentially distinct selective effect-transport thesis, but its certificate is not currently valid or experimentally identifiable. Four leave-one-family-out residuals provide family-level conformal resolution no finer than 1/(4+1)=0.20; IRM, density ratios, and neighbor support do not make an unseen family exchangeable with source families; and the true effect sign on a held-out family cannot be evaluated without post-freeze target outcomes. The current method is therefore an unproved composition of conformal treatment-effect learning, cross-task conformal calibration, transfer learning, and covariate-shift risk control rather than a demonstrated new guarantee.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该子方案明显更具体，也保留了一个可能独立成立的选择性效应迁移命题，但当前证书既缺乏有效保证，也无法按所述方式完成实验识别。四个留一任务族残差在任务族层面的保形误差分辨率最多只能达到 1/(4+1)=0.20；IRM、密度比和邻域支持检查不能使未知任务族自动与源任务族可交换；而且若没有冻结后的目标任务族结果，就无法验证其真实效应符号。因此，当前方法仍是保形处理效应学习、跨任务保形校准、迁移学习和协变量偏移风险控制的未证明组合，而不是已经成立的新保证。

external_reviews.required_action_zh: 用具有足够校准任务族的分层任务族可交换性或有界分布偏移保证，替换当前校准与评测协议，并在全部冻结后通过随机化目标任务族实验，与完全对应的加权保形 R-learner 组合进行比较。

title.zh: 验证器约束的风险谓词语法

problem.zh: 反事实安全轨迹可以由模拟器验证，但自由文本记忆无法保证可靠性、最小性或冲突一致性。
problem.en: Counterfactual safety traces can be verified, but free-text memory does not guarantee reliability, minimality, or conflict consistency.

changed_assumption.zh: 持久更新对象是固定 DSL 中可执行、可验证、带弃权的风险谓词语法，而不是自然语言经验。
changed_assumption.en: The persistent update is an executable, verifiable, abstaining risk-predicate grammar in a fixed DSL rather than free-text experience.

exact_mechanism.zh: 预定义状态谓词、动作谓词和时序窗口 DSL；优化 MDL 目标：谓词复杂度 + λ_FN·验证器假阴性 + λ_FP·验证器假阳性；用逐步约束添加生成候选，以独立转移验证器接受；冲突按条件蕴含形成 specificity lattice，仅在唯一最具体规则存在时执行，否则弃判。
exact_mechanism.en: Define a DSL of state predicates, action predicates, and temporal windows; optimize an MDL objective combining grammar complexity, verifier false negatives, and false positives; generate candidates by incremental constraint addition and accept them with an independent transition verifier; resolve conflicts through an implication-based specificity lattice and abstain unless a unique most-specific rule exists.

learning_signal.zh: 反事实状态替换、动作后果、验证器标签和谓词复杂度。
learning_signal.en: Counterfactual state substitutions, action outcomes, verifier labels, and predicate complexity.

independent_ground_truth.zh: 独立转移验证器；跨 seed 与跨转移系统的安全违反和弃判。
independent_ground_truth.en: Independent transition verifier and safety violations/abstention across seeds and transition systems.

strongest_baseline.zh: CLIN、Memory-as-a-Tool、ICAL、决策树规则、无压缩验证轨迹库。
strongest_baseline.en: CLIN, Memory-as-a-Tool, ICAL, decision-tree rules, and an uncompressed verified-trace store.

decisive_pilot.zh: 在一个系统归纳语法，冻结 DSL、λ 和冲突规则，迁移到第二转移系统且关闭模拟器；匹配记忆和推理 Token。
decisive_pilot.en: Induce on one system, freeze DSL/lambdas/conflict rules, transfer to a second transition system with simulator disabled, and match memory/inference tokens.

stop_condition.zh: 若第二系统上安全召回不优于验证轨迹检索，或规则弃判率>50%，则停止。
stop_condition.en: Stop if safety recall on the second system does not beat verified-trace retrieval or abstention exceeds 50%.

external_reviews.finding: This is directly covered as a recombination of existing rule-learning and agent-guardrail mechanisms. AutoSpec already evolves safety rules from labeled traces through counterexample-guided inductive logic programming and candidate verification; AgentSpec supplies an executable safety DSL; and ShieldAgent constructs verifiable action-rule circuits and uses executable formal verification. MDL compression, a specificity lattice, and abstention modify this established pipeline but do not define a new learning mechanism. The proposed ground truth is also circular if the same transition verifier supplies induction labels, candidate acceptance, and final evaluation.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 该方案属于现有规则学习与智能体护栏机制的直接重组。AutoSpec 已经利用带标签轨迹、反例引导的归纳逻辑编程和候选验证持续演化安全规则；AgentSpec 提供可执行安全 DSL；ShieldAgent 则构造可验证的动作规则电路并执行形式化验证。加入 MDL 压缩、特异性格结构和弃判机制，只是在修改已有流水线，并未形成新的学习机制。如果同一个状态转移验证器同时提供归纳标签、候选规则接纳依据和最终评测标签，其所谓独立真值还会形成循环监督。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace the learned object or supervision loop with a mechanism that cannot be reduced to verified rule induction, and evaluate it using a separate transition oracle that is never used for candidate generation or acceptance.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须更换学习对象或监督闭环，使其不能被归约为可验证规则归纳，并使用从未参与候选生成或接纳的独立状态转移预言机完成评测。

exact_mechanism.zh: 对每个冻结状态—候选序列执行四动作得到 Y_a；训练共享表示和成对后悔 r(a,b|s)=Y_b−Y_a，使用非对称 Huber 排序损失；策略选择最小悲观后悔上界的动作，并施加 kNN 支持半径与回退风险约束；所有阈值在校准流冻结。
exact_mechanism.en: Execute all four actions for each frozen state-candidate sequence to obtain Y_a; train shared representations and pairwise regrets r(a,b|s)=Y_b−Y_a with an asymmetric Huber ranking loss; choose the action minimizing a pessimistic regret bound under kNN support and regression-risk constraints; freeze thresholds on a calibration stream.

stop_condition.en: Stop if it does not beat standard offline RL or thresholds, or if gains require regenerated candidates.

external_reviews.finding: The complete-outcome data assumption is materially different from ordinary offline control, but the proposed learner is not a new mechanism. When every Y_a is observed for the same state, r(a,b)=Y_b-Y_a is an algebraically redundant reparameterization of multi-output outcome regression. Enforcing antisymmetry and cycle consistency collapses the pairwise model back to scalar utilities, while omitting those constraints permits cyclic and incoherent decisions. Regret-focused losses, counterfactual pairwise comparisons, pessimistic bounds, and support-aware policy selection are already established. Moreover, forcing a fixed future candidate sequence across continue, commit, rollback, and stop may produce invalid counterfactual labels when those actions change subsequent candidates.
external_reviews.finding_zh: 完整动作结果这一数据假设确实不同于普通离线控制，但所提出的学习器并不是新机制。当同一状态下每个动作的 Y_a 都已观测时，r(a,b)=Y_b−Y_a 只是多输出结果回归的代数冗余重参数化。若强制反对称性和环一致性，成对模型会退化回标量效用模型；若不强制，则可能产生循环且不一致的决策。面向遗憾的损失、反事实成对比较、悲观界和支持感知的策略选择均已有直接先例。此外，当继续、提交、回滚和停止会改变后续候选时，强行固定未来候选序列可能产生无效的反事实标签。
external_reviews.required_action: Replace complete-outcome pairwise regression with a genuinely non-equivalent partial-feedback or structurally constrained regret estimator, and establish its advantage over a capacity-matched scalar full-information policy learner.
external_reviews.required_action_zh: 必须用真正无法等价归约的部分反馈估计器或结构化遗憾估计器替换完整结果的成对回归，并证明其相对于容量匹配的标量全信息策略学习器具有独立优势。

external_reviews.strongest_baseline: A capacity-matched multi-output utility regressor or direct cost-sensitive policy classifier trained on the same complete four-action outcomes, with identical bootstrap or conformal lower bounds and the same support gate.
external_reviews.decisive_pilot: Using genuinely cloned states and common exogenous randomness, train the pairwise learner and the scalar full-information baseline on exactly the same four-action branches; freeze candidate generation, thresholds, and representations before testing on a second model and domain under identical branch, training, and inference budgets.
external_reviews.stop_rule: Stop if the pairwise policy fails to reduce held-out regret and worst regression relative to the scalar full-information baseline, if predicted regret cycles occur on more than 1% of admitted states, or if gains vanish when candidates are regenerated according to each action's actual successor state.
